title: Perirobot space representation for HRI: measuring and designing collaborative workspace coverage by diverse sensors
benchmark_measurement: This paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. The research focuses on sensor coverage for human-robot interaction.
findings: This paper contains no findings related to religion, as it is a technical paper on robotics and sensor placement.
